s1.syndrome_frame: Acute to subacute onset of painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions with a mixed inflammatory cell infiltration and epidermal hyperplasia
salient_findings: Pustules and hemorrhagic-crusted plaques on the scalp, legs, arms, and trunk
Keloidal plaques on the face
Difficulty walking due to skin lesions
Epidermal hyperplasia and exocytosis of neutrophils on histopathology
Dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration with microabscesses
key_facts: Teenaged male patient
2-week history of skin lesions
Lesions began as pustules and developed into painful, itchy plaques
Prior treatment with prednisolone, clindamycin, and fluconazole
Patient continued to develop new lesions despite treatment
Difficulty walking due to skin lesions
HIV test was negative
Punch biopsy from arm showed epidermal hyperplasia and exocytosis of neutrophils
Dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration with microabscesses
No granulomas or multinucleated giant cells on histopathology
Negative periodic acid-Schiff staining

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions with a mixed inflammatory cell infiltration and epidermal hyperplasia

shortlist.label: Sweet syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of painful, itchy, and bleeding skin lesions with a dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration and microabscesses

shortlist.label: Generalized pustular psoriasis
shortlist.why_kept: Pustules and ulcerated plaques with a history of developing new lesions despite treatment

shortlist.label: Acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute onset of pustules and ulcerated plaques with a history of prior treatment with antibiotics and antifungals

shortlist.label: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Pustules and ulcerated plaques with a history of developing new lesions and a mixed inflammatory cell infiltration

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of painful, itchy plaques and pustules, along with histopathological findings of epidermal hyperplasia, dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration, and microabscesses, is consistent with Sweet syndrome. The lack of response to prior treatments and the presence of systemic symptoms also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: While pyoderma gangrenosum can present with painful ulcers, the histopathological findings and the initial presentation of pustules and plaques are more consistent with Sweet syndrome.

rejected.label: Generalized pustular psoriasis
rejected.why: The histopathological findings of microabscesses and dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration are not typical of generalized pustular psoriasis, which usually shows a more uniform pustular eruption.

rejected.label: Acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and histopathological findings do not match the typical presentation of acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, which is often associated with a recent medication exposure and shows a more superficial pustular eruption.

rejected.label: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis
rejected.why: The histopathological findings of epidermal hyperplasia and dense dermal-mixed inflammatory cell infiltration are not consistent with subcorneal pustular dermatosis, which typically shows a more superficial pustular eruption with minimal dermal inflammation.
